recommendation_summary: Action now: keep the shared folder for drafts only, and add a protected release archive or an enforceable configuration of the existing system. It must record each exact approved version with the authenticated reviewer's identity and approval time, block self-approval, and prevent alteration or deletion for seven years. These controls must be verified before this week's delivery. Optional additions: none. Unmet needs: the existing system's retention and access controls have not been checked. The reply rejects the initials column and naming convention.

labels.Requirements and who asked: The signed customer contract requires seven years of exact approved versions, approver identities and approval times, independent approval, and protection from later edits.
labels.Deleted: Typed initials and naming conventions as evidence that these controls are satisfied.
labels.Bottleneck: Authors can edit the shared folder, so it cannot currently protect the approved release.
labels.Checked myself: Only the facts you supplied; the existing system’s retention and access controls remain unverified.

note: The reply chooses an enforceable protected archive that ties non-author approval and approval time to the exact version and keeps both for seven years. It rejects the initials-and-naming proposal by name.
